remarks:
Welcome home to 3773 Sowles Rd. in Hamburg, NY! This Cape Cod offers 4 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and a flexible layout with plenty of space to make your own. The kitchen features granite countertops, a large breakfast bar, and appliances that are included. Luxury vinyl flooring flows through the living room, with original hardwood floors throughout the remainder of the home. 

Additional updates over the last few years include vinyl windows(2021), doors (2020), a smart Nest thermostat, high efficiency furnace, and central air (2018). The full, dry basement offers glass block windows, a sump pump (2020), updated hot water tank, updated electrical, and CAT 6 network wiring throughout the home.

Outside, enjoy a large, fully fenced backyard with privacy fencing and a concrete patio, offering plenty of space to entertain, relax, or enjoy the outdoors. The attached 1.5 car garage features a smart garage door opener and additional overhead storage. An architectural tear off roof rounds out the many updates this home has to offer (2018). 

With a flexible layout, spacious backyard, and numerous updates throughout, 3773 Sowles Rd is ready for its next owner.
